messages:
maria: Short sync: need final decisions for Reserved Pools billing and emergency behavior before I lock the roadmap doc. Key items: pro-rata rules, emergency throttle default, token vs time accounting, and what we expose to customers.

kenji: For GA I prefer token-based accounting (easier to correlate to cost). Expose seconds too if customers ask.

sarah: Runtime note: token accounting maps well to rate limits but we must ensure prewarm credits cover the warmup penalty (~80-120ms p95) or customers will see SLO blips during first requests.

elaine: Sales asks for a clear pricing example and a simple rule for upgrades/downgrades. Customers hate surprises.

maria: Proposal for GA defaults: contiguous 5m windows, token-based accounting, no carryover, pro-rate charges only for upgrades mid-window, downgrades take effect next billing cycle. Does that sound ok?

product_lead: Keep GA conservative. Approve those defaults. Pilot customers can get special terms.

tom_ops: We need an emergency_global_throttle with a sensible default. Ops recommendation: default to 50% of cluster ingress rps; allow manual override with audit log. Also add a P1 alert when throttle engages >1m.

ops-bot: /event-schema registered: emergency_throttle_event {cluster_id,pool_id,ts,operator,duration_s,prev_rps,new_rps,reason} :white_check_mark:

kenji: Telemetry and billing export: daily BigQuery snapshot with date,tenant_id,pool_id,total_tokens,prewarm_credits_used,eviction_count. Also keep 30d histograms and 90d percentiles.

sarah: Autoscale tweaks: prefer queue-based scale triggers but add token-rate delta backstop. Proposal: scale_up when queue_len > 250 sustained 60s OR token_rate > 2.5x baseline for 45s; require 3 confirm windows.

maria: UX & acceptance: console must show active window, remaining tokens, recent warnings within 5s. Acceptance criteria for canary: p95 regression <7% for top-10 tenants, eviction_rate <0.5% sustained. Canary plan: ramp to 5% over 12h, hold 48h.

elaine: I'll draft a pricing snippet showing prorated upgrade example and language that no carryover is GA default.

tom_ops: Implement manual override (15m max) with audit (operator, reason). Also add admin page to toggle global throttle.

product_lead: Add contingency: if canary sees >5% p95 regression for top-10 tenants or eviction spikes, pause rollout and investigate.

maria: Thanks. Action items: kenji=billing export + metric names, sarah=prewarm budget + autoscale config, tom_ops=emergency throttle UI + audit, elaine=pricing blurb, me=update roadmap PR. Target: feature flags by end of sprint (2w), GA in ~6w if canary green.

kenji: Metric name suggestions (OTLP): ri.dedicated.tokens_consumed{tenant,pool}, ri.dedicated.window_active{pool}, ri.dedicated.evictions_total{tenant,pool,reason}. Keep cardinality low.

maria: Final question: should we expose fragmented ledger (internal fractional credit use) to advanced customers in the UI or keep it hidden for GA?

product_lead: Keep it hidden for GA. Expose via contract.

maria: Great. I'll push the PR and call this consensus unless objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
